step1_issue.title: state-scanner: surface in-flight (mid-implementation) carry-forward items, not just ship-time consolidation
step1_issue.body:
## 现象

长周期 OpenSpec change (本提案场景: TH v0.3.2 chat MVP, 8 个 dev session 累积) 在实施过程中会累积 carry-forward 决策 (本批不修, 留下次), 主流程当前是把这些项**内联标注**进 `openspec/changes/<change>/tasks.md` 的 task 注释里 (e.g. `[code-ready: ... carry-forward: X]`)。

这些项**只在 ship 时**汇总到 `project_v<X>_carry_forward.md` memory 文件 (历史 v0.2.1 / v0.2.2 / v0.3.0 / v0.3.1 都是此 pattern)。

## 问题

**implementation 期间 (mid-flight, 未 ship)**, state-scanner 不主动识别这些 carry-forward 注释:

- `tasks.md` 内联 `carry-forward` 标记不在 state-scanner 任何 phase 输出里
- session memory 文件虽然 MEMORY.md 索引能加载但 carry-forward 项目埋在长 markdown body 里, 不被 surface
- 在多 session 接手场景 (e.g. 4 天后下个 dev session, 另一个 AI 实例 / 用户), 接手者看不到这些累积的"待处理"项, 除非主动 grep 或回忆

实际后果: 真实 case (TH v0.3.2) 8 个 session 累积 ≥ 7 项 carry-forward (含 race condition / 用户体验 bug / 架构 gap), 全部内联 tasks.md, **state-scanner 报告里完全不可见**。直到用户主动问"这些是不是会被遗忘?"才暴露问题。

## 预期

state-scanner 应该有机制 surface in-flight carry-forward, 不光在 ship 时聚合:

- 选项 A: 新 Phase 1.X "Active openspec carry-forward scan" — grep active `openspec/changes/*/tasks.md` 内联 `carry-forward` 标记, 输出条数 + 前 N 项 brief
- 选项 B: 通用化 — 检测任意 `TODO/FIXME/carry-forward` 标注 count from active spec dirs
- 选项 C: 约定 — 维护 `openspec/changes/<change>/_carry_forward.md` running file, scanner 发现并 surface
- 选项 D: 项目级 `.aria/state-checks.yaml` 推荐配置加 carry-forward grep check (本质把 surface 责任下放 user 自配)

## 实例上下文 (供参考)

- 项目: TH v0.3.2 chat MVP (Path C, FastAPI Feishu webhook)
- session 数: 8 (持续 ~13 天 cycle)
- carry-forward 累积 ≥ 7 项, 含 race condition (write_raw_file in git_lock 范围错位致 burst 期间同文件多 commit), users_cache scope 重批待办, channel_type 启发式 bug, events_received.jsonl 缺失, dispatch-layer workspace 持久化 gap (跨 /accept /judge /reflect), CF tunnel 临时 → stable URL 切换, 18:22 老 commit retroactive 缺 trailer
- 全部内联 `openspec/changes/v0-3-2-chat-mvp/tasks.md`, 无 memory 集中索引
- 第 8 session 末用户问"是不是会被遗忘?"才意识到 surface gap

cases.expected: If state-scanner surfaced in-flight carry-forward, scan.py would scan active openspec/changes/*/tasks.md for inline [carry-forward: ...] markers
cases.actual: Only 2 hits, both unrelated to inline tasks.md scanning: SKILL.md L178 reads handoff.latest_path (session handoff doc, not tasks.md annotations); state-snapshot-schema.md L588 mentions prior-session carry-forward priority. scan.py has NO inline [carry-forward: ...] scan of active spec dirs.
cases.notes: Capability gap confirmed by code inspection. Issue is a feature request (missing capability), not a runtime defect, so 'reproduction' = verifying the capability is genuinely absent.

cases.input: git branch -a / git log --all --since=2026-05-01 / forgejo GET pulls?state=open — search #89/#90/carry-forward
cases.expected: An in-flight branch/PR/commit implementing carry-forward surfacing would appear
cases.actual: No PRs open. No branches/commits referencing #89/#90 or this feature. The two remotes/*/feature/m3-carryover-* branches are unrelated M3 HCL-crons / result-path work, not state-scanner surfacing.

triage_notes.issue_disambiguation: Teammate recalled '#89 or #90'. Both are open, same reporter, filed 7 min apart (2026-05-08), same TH v0.3.2 case, same root problem (state-scanner blind to in-flight carry-forward). #89 (triaged here) is broader framing with options A-D; #90 is the more specific Phase 1.6 / Phase 2 framing. #90 is a near-duplicate of #89 and should be consolidated.
